label: Italian Summer
aesthetic: Riviera tailoring-lite: unstructured light jacket or tonal beige-ivory-brown, pleated trousers, suede loafers.
signature_pieces: knit polo or tee under a jacket
double-pleated trouser (Incotex/Brunello) in ivory, sand, stone
suede loafer or Summer Walk (white sole)

min_signals.why: at least 2 of: suede/white-sole loafer, pale/linen trouser, soft jacket, knit polo/linen/fine knit

banned.why: A white leather sneaker only on Weekend/Travel.
No heavy, country or street tops; camp collar is Faloni, henley/zip is 545.
No structured, workwear or winter outer.

pairing_rules.why: Separates it from Faloni: either a soft jacket, or a fully tonal ivory/beige/brown core.
A mule without a jacket is Faloni; IS uses a mule only with a jacket.
Italian denim is worn under a soft jacket.
Field jacket only over a tee/knit with pale trousers (R18).

out.modifier: Soft jacket + knit polo + ivory trouser + suede loafer

fall.modifier: Early fall only: suede jacket/taupe blazer

card_note: Riviera ease: soft light jacket or tonal ivory-beige, pleats, suede loafers.
gap_note: No white-sole Summer Walk or linen jacket: taupe/ivory blazers + suede loafers stand in.

must_differ.faloni: IS needs a soft jacket or an all-tonal core; mule only with a jacket.
must_differ.italianwinter: IS is spring/summer with pale trousers; IW is fall/winter with wool/cord.
must_differ.polo: IS bans tassels and navy structured blazers.

scoring.empty_state: In winter, hide the row with the note 'Italian Summer is a warm-weather chip; try Italian Winter'.

gaps: No linen or unconstructed jacket beyond Taupe g_juk45cokjxxy, Ivory DB g_98p2sivflrxg, Beige cord blazer g_whgv0gu6m08l (cord = fall).

weekday/winter.note: No white-sole Summer Walk or linen jacket: taupe/ivory blazers + suede loafers stand in.

current_code_scoring: houses.ts italianSummer: required tokens (knit polo/linen + pale trouser + suede loafer/summer walk). lookFitsOccasion has NO italianSummer branch and the row ignores the fingerprint, so the IS row == All row in every simulated context.
